name: control-center
summary: One navigable control centre for the kit: /kit (and its /helpers alias, plus alt+m) opens a searchable hub of levels and pages — profile, effort, thinking, security, autonomy, work, session, connect and system. Rows show their current value where a process registry publishes one, fall back to the typed command, and hold back any change that lowers oversight until a confirmation the terminal alone can answer.
